title: nephrodium chrysocoma
intro: Nephrodium chrysocoma, commonly known as Lady fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lady fern include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, gout, and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Lady fern include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
